images.title: Overlap to compare
images.purpose: Show that two angles that lie exactly on top of each other when overlapped are equal.
images.composition: Two identical angles side by side and one overlapped version below, centred.
images.exact_structure: Top left: angle AOB with arms OA and OB, teal #0072B2. Top right: angle XOY of exactly the same opening and arm length, amber #E69F00. Below, centred: both angles placed with O on O, OA on OX and OB on OY, drawn as one angle with teal and amber lines coinciding. Exactly 2 separate angles, 1 overlapped angle, all arms equal length.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Angles that fit exactly on each other are equal.
images.description: Two identical angles AOB in teal and XOY in amber, and below them one overlapped angle where both coincide.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the arms that land on each other.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
